dog.description_text:
Looking for a young dog who’s past the tiny-puppy stage but still has plenty of puppy fun left? Meet Duke! 💙
Duke is 9–10 months old, about 30 lbs., and a mixed breed with a happy, social personality that makes him pretty easy to fall for.
He’s pretty much the perfect size—not too big, not too small—and probably doesn’t have a whole lot more growing to do…
Unless, of course, you feed him lots. 😂🍗
Duke has the kind of personality that makes fitting into a family look easy.
dog.name: Duke
